'''Havenshire''' is a town in the [[Scarlet Enclave]] that is located just north of [[New Avalon]] and southeast of [[Gloom Hill]]. Havenshire comprises the [[Havenshire Mine]], a stable, farmlands, a crypt, and a lumber mill.
